title: Dismissed with Prejudice
summary: On Tuesday, March 17, 2015, in the Circuit Court of the City of Norfolk with sixteen family members and university allies filling the gallery behind him, Jordan's independent tax return, insurance binders, power chair order, 4.0 GPA, and signed open-heart CABG surgical consent utterly demolish his mother's guardianship petition—ending in a dismissal with prejudice and a six-figure civil settlement on the drive home up U.S. Route 460 West.
